Round 23 · The rebuild, measured against the real thing

Look first. Measure second.

R23 fixed the two things that broke the illusion last round: the canyon is now bright and open (walls to the flanks, the cream sky showing down the centre — no more dark tunnel), and you can aim in it again — a camera-roll-axis bug had railed the sight off the enemies, and locks now form there at parity with the open stages. The tanker airframe is finished (swept fin + measured swept-wedge wings). Zero regression. It rises to 9.3.
“The canyon is a bright open canyon now, not a brown tunnel, and I can finally lock onto things in it like anywhere else. The refuel tanker is a proper winged transport. Nothing outside the canyon moved a pixel. What's left is making the canyon walls tall cliffs instead of rocky hills.”
